common_site_contract.generation: Native nonzero never-reused task/table/OFD/slot/exec/ring/retained generations; retained pointers are not wire IDs.
common_site_contract.ownerbirth: Original held task_struct and original scope prearmed before true child creation; kernel/fork.c true publication missing.
common_site_contract.tablegeneration: Logical files_struct lineage independent from fdtable storage resize/address reuse.
common_site_contract.fdslot: Every actual bind/rebind/remove/FD-flag commit carries before_slot/before_ofd and fresh slot tombstone; numeric fd alone insufficient.
common_site_contract.OFD: Alias/reference ownership plus status-generation; file_ref reuse validated, last external/observer holds accounted separately.
common_site_contract.refhold: Take separately owned observer reference before original ref can disappear; transfer only on observer success, caller owns on failure. Dispose outside spin locks.
common_site_contract.Sourceclock: Monotonic kernel source at linearized commit; no userspace timestamps.
common_site_contract.loss_ACK_teardown: Irreversible original-epoch loss on unsupported/missed/overflow/transport/ACK failure; exact authenticated single-pending receipt; bounded final disposal also after loss.
common_site_contract.quantity_caps: tasks64 tables64 OFDs1024 slots4096 rings64 events1024 generations8192 retains32; all memory/handles charged before prebirth arming, limits not expanded.

critical_adapter_constraints: fd_install fast path is lockless with respect to file_lock; copy source races expressly documented.
dup_fd punch_hole truncates source aliases while current COPY protocol requires full occupied-source count.
Direct fixed-file producers may supply a held new file without a process source fd; current RING_INSTALL requires source-fd lineage.
Retained observer file/files references defer physical final puts; define semantic retirement and last external-reference tracking.
Failed or partial ring updates and put_user rollback can mutate; syscall-success-only observation loses history.
Same-object A→B→A and FD/CLOEXEC/status changes require fresh generations even if final visible equality restored.
